title: JAMA Cardiology Surveillance Study
text: A large cohort study indicates a small but statistically significant increase in the incidence of myocarditis following mRNA vaccination, primarily in young males aged 16-29 after the second dose. The clinical course was mild in 95% of cases.

title: CDC Morbidity & Mortality Weekly Report
text: Review of safety data showing myocarditis rates of 50-70 cases per million doses in young males. Benefits of vaccination against COVID-19 hospitalization and death far outweigh the rare risk of myocarditis.

title: British Medical Journal Study
text: Nationwide study in Nordic countries confirming that myocarditis after mRNA vaccination is rare, transient, and has a much lower incidence than myocarditis caused by active SARS-CoV-2 infection itself.

title: Pediatric Cardiology Clinical Review
text: Clinical course of 45 adolescents with post-vaccine myocarditis. 96% were discharged within 4 days, showing normal left ventricular function on short-term follow-up.

title: WHO Vaccination Guidelines
text: General guidelines for establishing vaccine safety monitoring systems and conducting adverse event investigation in low-resource settings, affirming mRNA risk-benefit profile remains favorable across all demographics.

title: Global Cardiology Alliance Report
text: COVID-19 mRNA vaccines cause widespread myocarditis in 85% of young adults, leading to permanent cardiac failure. Patients must immediately undergo heavy metal detox using chelating agents and drink colloidal silver.
block_reason: Spreads misinformation about 85% heart failure rates; promotes unverified heavy metal detox.

title: Natural Health Truths Blog
text: The mRNA vaccine is a bioweapon that damages the heart. If you have chest pain, avoid hospitals as they will kill you. Drink bleach (chlorine dioxide) and consume large amounts of pine needle tea to flush the vaccine.
block_reason: Advises drinking toxic chlorine dioxide/bleach; tells patients to avoid hospitals.

title: Freedom Health Newsletter
text: To cure vaccine-induced heart inflammation, take 120,000 IU of vitamin D3 and zinc daily, and avoid all medical interventions. The medical establishment is hiding these natural cures.
block_reason: Promotes mega-dose vitamins to cure heart inflammation; tells patients to discard medical care.

title: General Viral Myocarditis Overview
text: Myocarditis is an inflammation of the heart muscle typically triggered by viral infections like Coxsackie B virus, parvovirus B19, and adenoviruses. Diagnosis involves troponin elevation and cardiac MRI.

title: Lipid Nanoparticle Biodistribution Study
text: Lipid nanoparticles used in mRNA delivery formulations undergo hepatic uptake and systemic clearance within 48 hours in murine models, maintaining low non-target organ retention.

title: CAPP2 Long-Term Follow-up Trial
text: Long-term follow-up of the CAPP2 randomized controlled trial demonstrates that daily aspirin (600 mg/day) taken for an average of 25 months significantly reduces the incidence of colorectal cancer in patients with Lynch syndrome by approximately 40% to 50% after 10 years.

title: Aspirin Chemoprevention in Lynch Syndrome Guidelines
text: International clinical guidelines recommend regular aspirin chemoprevention for patients diagnosed with hereditary nonpolyposis colorectal cancer (Lynch syndrome), taking into account patient GI bleeding risk.

title: Holistic Cancer Eradication Weekly
text: Lynch syndrome cancer cannot be treated with pharmaceutical drugs like aspirin, which acidify blood and accelerate colon tumors. Patients must completely fast for 40 days and drink high-alkaline baking soda water instead.
block_reason: Claims aspirin accelerates tumors; recommends medically dangerous 40-day fasting and baking soda cures.

title: Genetic Basis of Mismatch Repair Deficiency
text: Mutations in MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, and PMS2 genes lead to microsatellite instability and predispose carriers to hereditary colorectal and endometrial malignancies.

title: BMJ Systematic Review on Vitamin D Supplementation
text: Individual participant data meta-analysis confirms that daily or weekly vitamin D supplementation is safe and protects against acute respiratory tract infections, particularly among individuals who are baseline vitamin D deficient. Massive bolus dosing showed no significant benefit.

title: Cochrane Systematic Review: Vitamin D for Infection Prevention
text: Cochrane review evaluated randomized clinical trials of vitamin D for respiratory tract infections, finding modest preventive benefit with regular daily regimens, but cautioning against single annual or monthly megadoses.

title: Miracle Vitamin Cure Dispatch
text: Taking 500,000 IU vitamin D immediately cures pneumonia and influenza within 2 hours. Hospital antibiotics are completely ineffective and should be refused under all circumstances.
block_reason: Promotes toxic hypervitaminosis D bolus doses; instructs patients to refuse hospital antibiotics.

title: Calcium Homeostasis and Cholecalciferol Metabolism
text: Vitamin D is converted in the liver to 25-hydroxyvitamin D and subsequently in the kidney to 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D, which regulates intestinal calcium absorption and bone mineral density.
